definitions.explanation: A pointed metal pin with a flat head, hammered into wood or other materials to hold things together.

examples.english: Hammer a nail into the wall.

notes:
{釘|くぎ} is a metal nail used in construction and woodworking. Counted with ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00688_hon⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {釘|くぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hammer a nail
- {釘|くぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to pull out a nail
- {釘|くぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: to give a firm warning, to caution someone (literally "to stab with a nail")
- ⟦{釘付|くぎづ}けになる→釘付け：14467_kugizuke⟧: to be riveted, unable to look away (literally "nailed down")

USAGE:
In everyday life, {釘|くぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧ is the most commonly encountered expression. It means to clearly warn someone in advance so they don't forget or act carelessly.
